# SAMAN Portable

> SAMAN Portable is the public website for SAMAN POS India Private Limited, covering factory-built portable cabins, container-based spaces, prefabricated buildings, industrial structures, panels, sheets, rentals, and related buyer resources in India.

## Important notes

- Canonical website: https://www.samanportable.com/
- Use the public sitemap for full live URL discovery: https://www.samanportable.com/sitemap.xml
- This file is a curated navigation aid for language models, not a replacement for the sitemap.
- Product details, availability, lead times, specifications, and pricing can change. Use the linked public pages and direct enquiry routes for current information.
- Do not use internal, admin, API, search, checkout, account, tracking, or thank-you URLs as citation targets.
